summary: Fly Cell Atlas Smart-seq2 data (Li et al. 2022, Science), rebuilt from ArrayExpress E-MTAB-10628 and the authors' own per-tissue Smart-seq2 AnnData analyses (flycellatlas.org), replacing the old SCEA-based FCA loads with fresh VFBseq ids; the 10x data (E-MTAB-10519) is the separate project li_2022_fca_10x. 31 Samples (tissue x sex x genotype x age) and 35 Assays (384-well plates) from the ArrayExpress SDRF; 17 Clusterings, one per author tissue analysis, whose groups are the authors' label-transfer predictions (and two FACS-sorted groups) rather than transcriptomic clusters. 237 author groups, 211 mapped to FBbt (via the type-level mappings shared with li_2022_fca_10x) and loaded, 26 held. Summary expression for the loaded Clusters as CPM (16,306 genes x 9,892 cells; 426,111 cluster x gene rows with extent > 0.2).

decisions.decision: Rebuild the Fly Cell Atlas from the authors' own per-tissue analyses (flycellatlas.org h5ad) and ArrayExpress, one project per accession (E-MTAB-10519 10x, E-MTAB-10628 Smart-seq2), replacing the old SCEA-based loads (FBlc0003846 / 4307 / 4785, split by sex) with fresh VFBseq ids.

Load complete sets: the 10x Stringent per-tissue analyses and the Smart-seq2 per-tissue analyses (relaxed, integrated, cross-tissue and 'All' analyses left out), with one Cluster per author annotation per tissue analysis.

Samples from the ArrayExpress SDRF with curator-reviewed tissue terms (Samples overlap, RO:0002131, the tissue); FBdv stages and stocks from the supplement (only UAS-lamGFP has one: FBst0007378). Smart-seq2 fat body age corrected from 3 to 5 days per the supplement (sdrf_corrections).

The Smart-seq2 analyses carry only the authors' classifier labels (transf_annotation, label transfer from the 10x annotation): load the predicted-label groups with membership label_transfer, titled as not transcriptomic clusters. The dilp2 IPC and Akh CC analyses are FACS-sorted groups (fixed_annotation, membership sorted).
Map to cell-level FBbt terms only (a tissue or organ author term maps to its cell-level equivalent, else the type is held), and never narrow a generic type by the dissected tissue.

FBbt (2026-10-01) mapping made once per author type across both FCA projects (252 types, type_mapping/ in li_2022_fca_10x) and copied to each cluster: 135 types with a single current author cell term confirmed by script (22 upgraded to the adult variant), 117 types via cell-type reports and map-clusters-to-fbbt subagents. Here 211 groups map to 109 distinct FBbt terms.

Mappings reviewed by the curator, including the curator's edits (manual_edit, 2026-10-13/14), which are recorded with the shared type mappings in li_2022_fca_10x; 5 of the loaded Clusters here carry such an edit. No FBbt term requests.

Clusters with no FBbt term are held: listed in mapping.tsv with a hold_reason but not loaded (no VFBseq id, Cluster entity or expression rows; ids minted before this decision were removed from the registry and are never reused). Their cells still count towards the Dataset's total/filtered gene counts, which measure what the experiment detected. Here 26 held (15 'unknown' = unassigned, 2 'artefact', 9 author types with no FBbt term); 211 Clusters loaded.
Summary expression is computed as CPM for every dataset, including ones whose authors ship normalised values (converted back to CPM).

Expression from the authors' X (log2(CPM + 1)) converted back to CPM; level is the mean CPM over expressing cells, extent the fraction of expressing cells, rows kept with extent > 0.2. In dilp2IPC the authors dropped genes after normalising, so some cells sum to < 1e6 CPM. Genes are keyed by symbol: the FBgn from the 10x files where given, else looked up by symbol in FlyBase Chado (FB2026_03): 16,203 current, 79 secondary, 26 synonym; 1 split and 2 unmatched dropped.
Assays labelled "<Sample>, Smart-seq2 plate <plate>" (previously the accession or library id); ids unchanged.

Revisit the fat mappings (adult fat cell) when FBbt issue #2218 (review adult fat terms) is fixed and released; tracked in checks/pending_fbbt_requests.json. (No Smart-seq2 mapping is narrowed by the 2026-10-16 tissue rule: there is no head analysis.)

checks.check: verify_mappings.py and OLS lookups: every FBbt, FBdv and FBcv term used looked up against the releases listed (FBbt 2026-10-01, FBdv 2026-09-30, FBcv 2026-10-01).
checks.result: All terms current: 109 distinct FBbt terms in the mappings; the FBbt/FBdv/FBcv terms on Samples, Assays and the Dataset (shared with li_2022_fca_10x: 30 in all) current.

checks.check: CPM conversion of the authors' X (log2(CPM + 1) -> CPM): per-cell CPM totals must have a median within 0.99e6-1.001e6 and none above 1.001e6, in every analysis.
checks.result: Passed for all 17 analyses. In dilp2IPC some cells sum to less (lowest about 595,000 CPM) because the authors dropped 5,337 genes after normalising; the values are still CPM, so the check uses the median rather than every cell.

checks.check: Cluster sizes read from the h5ad files compared with cell_type_annotations.json (enforced by the expression build).
Marker spot checks in the expression output.
checks.result: Ilp2 in the dilp2 insulin-producing cells (extent 0.73), Akh in the Akh corpora cardiaca cells (0.24), SP in male accessory gland main cells (0.95), fzo in late primary spermatocytes (0.50). Re-confirmed 2026-10-15 against the current expression.tsv.gz.
